ctx.x: And so this Russian President of the Republic of Georgia gives a speech and the interpreter would say it in English. Then he'd say some more in Russian, then he'd say it in English and everything. And he gets through with his 22nd toast so he turns it over to Benny Goodman. And Benny

gets up and he starts to make a speech and the interpreter speaks in Russian and it's translated in English. This is funny, also. Benny goes into this long story about how he worked all his life. And he says, "A few years back a woman came into my life that changed everything." And his wife's with him and his two daughters, a stepdaughter and real daughter, and they're both preening, you know, wondering which one it's going to be. He says, "This woman has meant more to me and done for me," and goes on and on and…
And he said, "I'd like to propose a toast to Muriel Zuckerman."
